title: Transactions
description: data of GET /v1/transactions: the user's transaction ledger built from verified, final imported statements, oldest first, with totals. Money is integer minor units of `currency`; charges are negative. Categories are a classifier's guesses, gated to the vocabulary below; merchant text is untrusted, with personal data replaced at import (ADR-028).

account_id.description: <bank layout code>:<masked account reference>, e.g. santander_cl_cuentamatica:****3456 (ADR-028).

merchant.description: The statement line's description, with personal data replaced at import by placeholders such as [PERSON] (common/redaction.schema.json).

kind.description: From the statement, never from a model: on a checking account the amount's sign (income or purchase); on a credit card the line's kind as the layout reads it. A card_payment is the holder's own money (category movement) and counts as neither spending nor income.

classifier.description: What chose the category: a classifier name with its training-data hash, "rule" for income and card payments, or "user" when the user set it (PATCH /v1/transactions/{txn_id}, ADR-023).

confidence.description: The classifier's confidence, kept even when too low to accept; null for rules and for the user.

installment.description: Present when the line bills one cuota of a purchase in cuotas.

spending.description: Purchases and fees less refunds, per currency and category, largest first. The holder's own money is excluded: Movimientos (card payments, and anything the user marks movement) and Ahorro (savings lines, ADR-036).

income.description: Deposits per currency (category "income"), without the holder's own money (movement, savings).

savings.description: Money set aside in the holder's savings or investment products less money back from them, per currency (category "savings", ADR-036). Neither spending nor income. Set by a layout rule or by the user, never by a model.

spent.description: Spending: charges and fees less refunds (negative only if refunds exceed charges). Income: deposits. Savings: set aside less withdrawn (negative if more came back than went in).
